dedupe_keys.name: opssat ad annotated satellite telemetry anomaly benchmark

description: The OPS-SAT benchmark team publishes annotated telemetry from the European Space Agency's OPS-SAT CubeSat through Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. The own release lists segments.csv with observations from nine magnetometer and photodiode channels, and dataset.csv with extracted features and anomaly labels. A training-test split and example notebooks support comparison of anomaly detectors. These series can validate fault-monitoring components in satellite operations or digital-twin simulations. Coverage is one satellite mission and selected channels, not the full spacecraft telemetry or a representative fleet. A caveat is that sampling frequency, missing readouts and human segment labels affect model evaluation; extracted features must not be mistaken for independent sensor measurements. The article cites the stable concept DOI, which currently resolves to a later version than the first-version DOI linked by the code README. I read own Zenodo metadata and article Data Records without downloading CSV files or training a detector. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
